workflow: A database-like operation validates that its backing resource is available and begins obtaining parameter data from caller-supplied sequences or mappings.
A user-defined length, item, iteration, or conversion callback closes or releases the backing resource while the outer operation is still running.
The operation fails to revalidate the resource after the callback returns and continues parameter binding or execution.
A native routine is called through the cleared resource handle, causing a null dereference and process termination instead of a recoverable closed-resource error.
summary: Reentrant callback invalidates a backing resource before later use
